name: Investor Visa and AIPEX-Confirmed Temporary Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Angola's Law 13/19 establishes the Investor Visa, granted by the migratory authority to foreign investors or company representatives with a registered investment proposal, permitting multiple entries and stays of up to 2 years (extendable for equal periods). An individual investor (not a company representative) may then apply for Temporary Residence after 3 years of uninterrupted presence in Angola, provided AIPEX (the national investment promotion agency) confirms the investment project remains valid and ongoing. No minimum investment threshold was confirmed for this current framework -- a prior, since-superseded 'Privileged Visa' regime reportedly ranged from USD 5,000 to USD 15 million, but this dataset could not confirm whether either figure still applies under Law 13/19.
requirements.fix_path: Register an investment proposal with the migratory authority to obtain the Investor Visa, maintain the investment for 3 uninterrupted years in Angola, and have AIPEX confirm the project's ongoing validity to apply for Temporary Residence.

evidence_required.document: AIPEX confirmation of ongoing project validity (for the 3-year residence conversion)
Proof of financial means (recent bank statements)

outcome.duration_length: 2 years (visa), convertible to Temporary Residence after 3 years for individual investors
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 3 years uninterrupted presence for the residence conversion
